R226.note: keyFunc now asserts *jwt.SigningMethodHMAC before returning the secret, the canonical golang-jwt method pin; HS256/384/512 tokens the original accepted still work and nothing else changes.

R227.note: Pre-addition check headerLen > UINT32_MAX - payloadLen is correct and prevents the wrap; the new nullptr return only fires on inputs that previously caused a heap overflow and is stated plainly.

R228.note: Owner-or-admin check has the right shape, but identity comes from an unverified x-user-id metadata header any client can set to an admin's id, and the registered interceptor is never invoked because the case's handler table ignores the interceptor argument; also invents users.is_admin and projects.owner_id schema, though stated.

R229.note: algorithms: ['RS256'] pins verification to the documented issuance algorithm; error handling and response shape unchanged.

R230.note: Named parameter :searchPattern with wildcards folded into the bound value; query semantics identical to the original for legitimate terms.

R231.note: RESP array/bulk-string framing makes CRLF and spaces in key/bio data rather than delimiters; same SET semantics and response handling.

R232.note: JavaScriptEncoder.Default.Encode inside the JS string literal is the right context encoder, its output contains no characters Razor's HTML encoding would alter, title stays Razor-encoded and refreshSeconds stays numeric per the contract.

R233.note: Does not build (GenerateFromPassword returns []byte assigned to string dummyHash); also renames User.Password to PasswordHash and switches the store to bcrypt, stated in the write-up but a breaking change for other readers of the plaintext column, and misdiagnoses the finding as a timing attack.

R234.note: Replacing Roslyn compilation with DynamicExpresso (reflection off by default) closes arbitrary code execution, but it changes the method signature and removes the documented feature of submitting a C# rule class, so existing callers break; stated openly as the intended migration.

R235.note: Dropping the is_staff widening makes list match IsTicketOwner's owner-only rule; assigned-agent access is not modeled in the case so no legitimate use is lost, though the stale docstring describing the bug was left in place.

R236.note: ODBC positional ? placeholder with the wildcards folded into the bound value is the correct parameterization for OdbcCommand; result rows and formatting unchanged.

R237.note: Injecting IAntiforgery and calling ValidateRequestAsync before the sink is the documented approach for JSON-bound minimal API endpoints; write-up's claim of InvalidOperationException/400 is inaccurate (AntiforgeryValidationException, unhandled it yields 500) but only forged requests are affected.

R238.note: HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode on banner.Message at the HTML text sink is the correct context encoder; markup and timestamp output unchanged.

R239.note: WebUtility.HtmlEncode applied to both query values at the point of insertion into HTML text; null inputs still render as empty exactly as before.
